name: Required by Form mode
description: Makes fields required based on the active form mode.
project_description:
This module will help you to set a field required only in a specific form mode.

You can keep the field optional for some form modes while required for others.

This module's functionality is tested and supports these entities (node, user, taxonamy_term).

 How to use the module: 

- After enabling the module, go to any field you need to make it required and keep it not-required from the settings.

- Go to the form mode now, and in the field settings, you will be able to set this field required.

 This module is working great with other form mode modules like:

 form_mode_manager module.
